notes: Revised around the owner's UK platform/large-stock request. Nine prospects had no confidently matched standalone website in bounded checks; one existing website has concrete browser-confirmed content gaps. Eight have 23–77 opened advertised listings.
Research as of 10 October 2026. No post made on 10 October was verified. Explicit advert Last updated dates, undated stock, indexed evidence and secondary social mirrors are distinguished per record.

Ad counts are platform snapshots, not unique physical stock or availability. Do not add feeds together. Generic AutoTrader featured Dummy records were excluded; real Used cars and corroborating eBay/PistonHeads stock support counts.

Broadbent, Motors Castle and Car Market Yorkshire have matching Google profiles displaying Add website. Google missing website alone is insufficient: W M motors was excluded after the same premises matched a real own website under West Midlands Motors.

No standalone website found means bounded search absence, not proof of no website. Confirm domain, legal/trading identity, current premises and a direct owner-controlled contact before personalization.

Ranking is research/qualification priority, not a prediction of conversion, endorsement of dealer quality, verified budget or willingness to buy. Google/review scores are not treated as verified customer outcomes.
Public research only. No outreach, CRM/contact-history check, dealer build, publication, DNS or billing change. Private CRM remains Agency OS.
All six requested choices remain Auto Best, Modern, Import, App, Mobile and Signature (karento-best). Show-first choices do not alter templates.lock.json, dealer manifests or release acceptance.

Builds wait for accepted immutable releases and the qualified Cloudflare pilot/publisher. The sister's sales guide distinguishes visible demo capabilities from unimplemented finance, inventory feeds, live enquiry and CRM integrations.

Prior first-pass records and Walton reserve are preserved in reserves. W M motors is an identity/website reserve; Highgrove is excluded pending operator/legacy-domain resolution in the platform notes.

Forum and Facebook discovery did not supply an additional directly verified same-day no-website lead. Facebook throttling and conflicting mirror snapshots remain evidence limitations; no stale directory filler was used.
